title: 第12章 县尉第13章 黑狼
content_zh:
那沈衡带着众人出发，一路向着城外而去。
走了大约两个时辰，总算到了城外大寒山的山脚下。
而在此时，山脚下已经人山人海，汇聚了足足有千人之多。
“好多人。”
陆沉开口，只觉得热闹非凡。
这些人分为不同的派系，其中大多数陆沉都不认识。
不过在王家派系之中，看到了堂弟陆青河和大伯陆磐石。
两人在王家人群里，对着陆沉点了点头，但此时也不是交流的时候。
这一次王家派来了一百多人，其中大多数都是普通护院，抵达明劲以上的估计也是远超沈氏武馆。
就在这个时候，韩枫说道：“四大家族、七大武馆，十几个小家族，还有那些有点实力的小帮派基本都到齐了。”
陆沉闻言，不由询问道：“我对这些势力了解不多，还请韩兄指点一二。”
韩枫顿时露出笑容：“我们小寒城，分为内城和外城，人口足有数十万之多，各种家族、帮派、武馆等武道势力数十家。”
“其中最强就是内城四大世家，分别为王家、严家、马家、还有韩家，稍次的就是我们沈氏武馆等七大武馆。”
“至于剩下的帮派、小家族，平日里看似颇具威风，但在四大家族和七大武馆眼中，始终都还是上不得台面。”
陆沉闻言，不由露出好奇之色：“这四大家族这么强？”
“那是自然。”
韩枫点头，又小心的道：“这四大家族都有不止一位化境高人，更是掌握渔场、药园，矿产等珍贵资源。”
“说白了，他们才是小寒城真正的统治者，其他的家族和帮派都差了不少，哪怕七大武馆，面对他们也差了不止一筹。”
陆沉点了点头，大抵明白了原因。
渔场、药园、矿产能持续产出宝鱼、宝药、宝矿等资源，这些都是武者所需的关键资源。

仗着这些资源，四大家族就能源源不断的培育或拉拢武者。
七大武馆虽然也有化境，看似实力也在一个层次，但真实底蕴其实差了不是一个层次。
比如沈馆主看似威风，但是他门下那些入室弟子，其实都在各大家族、帮派、或者商铺中担任供奉。
否则只靠那点束脩，怕也养不起这么多的武者。
“哒哒哒。”
也就在两人交流的时候，远处传来一阵马蹄声。
众人抬头看去，只见远处笙旗招展，一群甲士从远处而来而来。
为首是一个身着甲胄的英武男子，只见其骑在一头高头大马上，有着一种睥睨八方的威严。
“见过都统大人。”
“老夫拜见赵县尉。”
眼看男子抵达，在场气氛顿时微微一变。
只见那些身居高位的化境高人，此时居然都纷纷放下身段对这人行礼。
陆沉心中不由微微一动，看向了一旁的韩枫。
那韩枫低下头，面色紧张的低声道：“这是小寒城县尉赵都统，其统领小寒城巡防营三千甲士，是城中实打实的实权派，也是唯一能压下四大家族的存在。”
content_en:
Then Shen Heng set off with everyone and headed all the way out of the city.
After walking for about two hours, we finally arrived at the foot of Dahan Mountain outside the city.
At this time, there was already a sea of ​​people at the foot of the mountain, with as many as a thousand people gathered.
"A lot of people."
Lu Chen opened his mouth and felt that it was very lively.
These people were divided into different factions, and most of them were unknown to Lu Chen.
However, among the Wang family faction, I saw my cousin Lu Qinghe and Dabo Lu Panshi.
The two of them nodded to Lu Chen in the crowd of Wang family, but this was not the time to communicate.
This time, the Wang family sent more than a hundred people, most of whom were ordinary guards, and those who arrived at Mingjin and above were probably far more than Shen's martial arts school.
At this time, Han Feng said: "The four major families, the seven major martial arts schools, a dozen small families, and those small gangs with some strength are basically here."
When Lu Chen heard this, he couldn't help asking: "I don't know much about these forces, so I would like to ask Brother Han for some advice."
Han Feng suddenly smiled: "Our Xiaohan City is divided into an inner city and an outer city, with a population of hundreds of thousands, and dozens of various families, gangs, martial arts schools and other martial arts forces."
"The strongest among them are the four major families in the inner city, namely the Wang family, the Yan family, the Ma family, and the Han family, followed by the seven major martial arts schools including our Shen Family Martial Arts School."
"As for the remaining gangs and small families, they seem to be quite prestigious on weekdays, but in the eyes of the four major families and the seven major martial arts schools, they are still not on the stage."
When Lu Chen heard this, he couldn't help but show curiosity: "Are these four major families so powerful?"
"That's natural."
Han Feng nodded and said cautiously: "These four major families have more than one expert in transformation, and they also control precious resources such as fishing grounds, medicine gardens, and minerals."
"To put it bluntly, they are the real rulers of Xiaohan City. The other families and gangs are far behind. Even the seven major martial arts schools are far behind them."
Lu Chen nodded, roughly understanding the reason.
Fishing grounds, medicine gardens, and mines can continuously produce resources such as treasure fish, treasure medicine, and treasure mines. These are key resources needed by warriors.
Relying on these resources, the four major families can continuously cultivate or win over warriors.
Although the seven major martial arts schools also have transformation realms, and their strength seems to be on the same level, their true background is actually not quite the same level.
For example, Master Shen may seem majestic, but his disciples are actually serving as worshipers in major families, gangs, or shops.
Otherwise, I'm afraid I won't be able to support so many warriors just by relying on that little cultivation.
"Ta-ta-ta."
While the two were communicating, there was a sound of horse hooves in the distance.
Everyone looked up and saw the Sheng flag fluttering in the distance, and a group of soldiers coming from a distance.
The leader was a heroic man in armor, riding on a tall horse with a majestic look.
"I've met Mr. Du Tong."
"I pay my respects to County Lieutenant Zhao."
Seeing the man arrive, the atmosphere suddenly changed slightly.
I saw that those who were in high positions and were experts at the Transformation Realm lowered their bodies to salute this man.
Lu Chen couldn't help but move slightly in his heart and looked at Han Feng aside.
Han Feng lowered his head and whispered nervously: "This is Xiaohan City County Lieutenant Zhao Dutong. He commands three thousand soldiers of the Xiaohan City Patrol Battalion. He is the real power in the city and the only one who can suppress the four major families."
